title: Try it now ! Join in on the Vacation 🌴
author: 6HandsProductions
selftext:
Would love for some support, feedback, testers, come out for a quick vacation themed game that was inspired by SkiFree

It's FREE game to play 🌞 

About the Development 

The game was developed through a hands-on creative process involving game design, experimentation, testing, and continuous refinement. AI-assisted tools were used throughout development to help with coding, troubleshooting, creative exploration, and development workflows.

The game's concept, creative direction, design decisions, testing, and overall development were guided by the developer.

Built with creativity, persistence, and a little help from technology.

Thank you for tuning in, I won't be reposting as I don't want to be kicked from the group or have my post removed. If you read all the way through. Your a real one 👏 

Should you have specific recommendations as far as ideas, new replays, coding suggestions, how I can go about making the game look or feel better ...

you can easily reach us at :

6handsproduction@gmail.com 

or visit us at: 

6handsproduction.com

Thank you

comments.author: Cole-Thomas52
comments.body: a vacation themed game inspired by SkiFree actually sounds pretty fun! are there different environments or challenges as u progress? the underwater and space elements in the artwork look interesting

replies.author: 6HandsProductions
replies.body:
You bet ! Give it a try , it's all free 😊 
You'll progress through 4 levels of fun and mystery with +15 comedic deaths for a fun suprise 

If you have suggestions or recommendations please feel free to reach back out.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/6HandsProductions please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.
